fact_text: Cement dispatches in FY24, the year ended 30 June 2024, were just over 45 million tons, well below the record of about 55 million tons set in FY21 and FY22.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: Cement dispatches in August 2024 were about 3.3 million tons, and July and August together were down year on year, the analyst says.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: Cement makers expanded capacity after 2020-21 and their utilisation has since fallen; Fauji Cement and Lucky Cement held better utilisation than Maple Leaf, according to the analyst.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: Over the long run in Pakistan, cement dispatches track GDP growth very closely, so the analyst reads falling dispatches as a sign of weaker development activity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: The analyst expects cement dispatches to rise if the coming monetary policy cuts interest rates, because lower borrowing costs would revive construction and development activity.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: International Steel's cold-rolled coil capacity utilisation was below 10 percent in FY24, according to the analyst's model of the company.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: The analyst says International Steel's galvanised pipe business has worked, offsetting weak cold-rolled coil volumes that high taxes and a slow business cycle pushed down.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: Flat steel demand comes from construction, car and motorcycle manufacturing and other industries, so weakness in those end markets drags on flat steel volumes.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: The analyst expects steel numbers to start improving in the second half of FY25, from around January 2025, once interest rates have begun to fall.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: Mari Petroleum's bonus and dividend go ex on 17 September 2024, and the analyst expects the share price to reset lower around that date.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: The analyst says Mari's results were good but had been expected for two to three years, so the new element in the announcement was the bonus issue.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: The analyst says investors who bought at about 2,500 to 2,600 can take the bonus and dividend, while late entrants near 3,200 to 3,300 may see little short-term gain.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: The analyst says Mari's gas production is among the largest in Pakistan and that its management is strong, which he regards as the basis for a longer-term holding view.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: Cement dispatches in August 2023 were about 4.56 million tons, against about 3.3 million tons in August 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: The new element in Mari Petroleum's results was a bonus share issue of 800 percent; the results themselves had been expected for two to three years.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)

fact_text: Mari Petroleum's share price was around PKR 2,700 about three to four months before 7 Sep 2024, the analyst said.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Mari Petroleum Stock Analysis | Why Cement Dispatches Are Declining | ISL & PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2024-09-07)
